subject: Annual Budget Process Ordinance
overview: The committee finalized and approved a proposed ordinance to codify the city's annual budget timeline and require quarterly financial reporting. The draft was amended to address administration concerns regarding staffing capacity before being reported favorably to the full City Council.

items.title: Resolution to Draft a Budget Ordinance (Paper 22-494)
items.summary: Approved as amended and referred to the full Council an ordinance codifying a structured annual budget calendar and quarterly financial reporting requirements. The committee adjusted language regarding annual progress reports on capital planning and budget needs to address administration concerns about staffing capacity and resource constraints.
